newsitem.title: USA: Offshore Energy sees 1997 results hurt.
newsitem.headline: Offshore Energy sees 1997 results hurt.

text.p: Offshore Energy Development Corp said Friday its 1997 operating results will be hurt by a number of developments in its exploration and development activities over the last several months.

It said it has engaged a financial adviser to identify potential industry or financial partners or sources of exploration and development capital to exploit an increasing inventory of what it believes to be high-quality exploration and development prospects.
While the company's primary objective is to accelerate the growth of its value, it will evaluate a possible sale of its stock or assets, Offshore Energy said.
